written_before: any locus-family computation, validation number or family statistic; only the outermost-locus size counts below were seen

seen_before_writing.outermost_loci: 465,242 (= the L1 runs of RD/long_loci/loci/dpann_Z; outermost nodes of Z L4b+ theta .02)

units.locus: outermost node of the frozen DPANN Z L4b+ theta .02 tree (RD/long_loci/loci/dpann_Z/L4bp_t0.02.parquet; gid interval s..e inclusive); size = e - s + 1 genes
units.nested: nodes of >= 10 genes nested inside a larger outermost locus are not separate units; each is represented by its outermost locus. Reported: how many large outermost loci contain >= 1 nested node of >= 10 genes, and the size of their largest nested node

gene_correspondence: Z list of gene a = entries of the calibrated table RD/calib/table for a's unique sequence with z >= 10.6, genome group (lineagefree emb_hom_average_t0.75) different from a's, best gene per genome as stored; ranked by z. Code copied from slot_rescue/code/score.py z_chunk (no change).

locus_link_rule.m(A->B): number of genes of locus A whose Z list holds a gene inside locus B
locus_link_rule.edge: m(A->B) >= 5 and m(B->A) >= 5 and m(A->B) >= |A|/3 and m(B->A) >= |B|/3
locus_link_rule.family: connected component of the edge graph over the 34,530 large loci; components of >= 2 loci are families (an edge always joins two genome groups because lists exclude the own group); loci with no edge are singletons
locus_link_rule.fallback: if the primary rule fails a validation bar and a variant passes every bar, use the first passing variant in the order 1/2, 1/4, and say so

ribosomal.runs: >= 16 genes carrying a Pfam Ribosomal_* domain on one contig with gaps <= 2 (the package rule), recomputed from Sharur pfam rows; each run is mapped to the large outermost locus with the largest gene overlap
ribosomal.metrics: families holding the mapped loci; share in the largest family; families needed for 90%; purity of that family = share of its member loci holding >= 5 ribosomal-protein genes
ribosomal.bars: largest family holds >= 0.80 of mapped run loci; <= 5 families hold 90%; purity >= 0.80

curated_systems.calls: system_proteins joined to defense_systems (DefenseFinder, by system_type), secretion_systems (TXSScan, by system_type), crispr_cas_systems with status crispr_cas or cas (CCTyper, by best_type); hydrogenase_classifications (HydDB, by reference_class) as a per-gene curated call
curated_systems.metrics: per type with >= 10 large loci overlapping a call: families holding them, share in the largest family, families for 90% (fragmentation); per family with >= 3 called member loci: share of called members whose dominant type equals the family's dominant type (purity)
curated_systems.bars: loci-weighted mean purity >= 0.80; Archaeal-T4P largest-family share >= 0.50; fragmentation of other types reported without a bar (one system type can sit in different neighborhoods)

family_description.gene_clusters: within a family, genes of member loci joined by Z-list links whose partner lies in another member locus of the same family; connected components = gene clusters
family_description.core: gene cluster present in >= 50% of member loci; variable = present in < 50%
family_description.order_conservation: per member: longest collinear subsequence (either orientation) of core clusters in consensus order / core clusters present; family value = median
family_description.unannotated: gene with no row in annotations (any source) and no CDD row (protein_resemblance); also reported: no Pfam/KOfam/KEGG row
family_description.edge: member locus with fewer than 3 genes between it and either contig end
family_description.lineages: genome groups (emb_hom_average_t0.75), GTDB phyla and orders from bins.taxonomy

classification.covered_core_cluster: core cluster with >= 50% of its genes inside a curated call, or whose genes carry (plurality) a housekeeping predicate (ribosomal_protein, rna_polymerase, atp_synthesis) or a KO of a KEGG module holding >= 3 core clusters of the family
classification.KNOWN: >= 2/3 of core clusters covered (basis named: curated type, or ribosomal / RNAP / ATPase / KEGG module id)
classification.KNOWN-EXTENDED: >= 2 covered core clusters and >= 3 uncovered core clusters and covered share < 2/3
classification.MOBILE: not KNOWN or KNOWN-EXTENDED and >= 10% of family genes carry a mobile tag (predicates mobile_element, transposase, integrase, phage_related) or a core cluster has a mobile-tag plurality
classification.DARK: otherwise, >= 50% of family genes unannotated by every source
classification.COHERENT-UNNAMED: otherwise, >= 50% of annotated core clusters share one process predicate from a fixed process list (carbohydrate_active/glycosyltransferase, transporter, secretion_component, defense_component, electron_transport/energy_metabolism, cofactor_biosynthesis, amino_acid_biosynthesis, lipid_metabolism, nucleotide_metabolism, dna_repair/replication, translation, cell_surface/adhesin, toxin/antitoxin)
classification.MIXED: residual: annotated, no single process (added because the five classes do not cover every family)

ranking.eligible: families not KNOWN with >= 3 genome groups, >= 2 GTDB orders and >= 5 member loci
ranking.score: mean percentile rank over: genome groups, orders, median size, mean core presence, order conservation, annotated share of core clusters

controls.lineage: counts in genome groups and orders everywhere; raw genome counts only beside them
controls.assembly: edge rate per family; top families need >= 50% of members away from contig edges
controls.null: (a) gene identities shuffled within genomes: each locus keeps its size and genome, its genes replaced by random genes of the same genome (seed 17); the link rule and components are rerun on the shuffled loci; family count, largest group breadth and families with >= 3 groups compared with observed. (b) the method's own whole-locus test: share of large loci whose root node passes the L4b test (n >= 2, Lambda >= tau, i.e. present in L4b_t0.02)
controls.hydrophobic: fraction ILVFMAWC per core cluster (median); >= 0.47 or TMHMM >= 3 helices flagged membrane before any fold
